title: Laredo Motor Carriers Director Priscilla Pantoja Johnson Graduates from National LEAD ATA Leadership Program
excerpt: Priscilla Pantoja Johnson, executive director of the Laredo Motor Carriers Association, has graduated from the American Trucking Associations' LEAD ATA leadership program, one of 16 trucking professionals in the 2025-2026 class.
content:
Priscilla Pantoja Johnson, executive director of the Laredo Motor Carriers Association (LMCA), has graduated from the American Trucking Associations' LEAD ATA leadership program, a year-long program that develops the next generation of trucking industry leaders.

Johnson was one of 16 professionals in the 2025-2026 LEAD ATA class. The class graduated Oct. 17, 2026, during the American Trucking Associations' Management Conference & Exhibition in Charlotte, North Carolina.

The Laredo Motor Carriers Association celebrated the achievement in an announcement Tuesday, Nov. 17, highlighting Johnson's work representing Laredo's trucking community on the national stage. Laredo is home to one of the busiest commercial crossings on the U.S.-Mexico border, and the association represents the local carriers moving freight through the region.

LEAD ATA combines industry education, professional networking and work on transportation policy. Its graduates join an alumni network of trucking professionals across the country.

Source: American Trucking Associations, Oct. 17, 2026; Laredo Motor Carriers Association announcement, Nov. 17, 2026.
